rxnorm_rxnav.name: RxNorm / RxNav API
rxnorm_rxnav.access: free public REST API; bulk historical RxNorm files require UMLS/UTS credentials
rxnorm_rxnav.coverage: current and historical concepts exposed by the API
rxnorm_rxnav.granularity: NDC, RxCUI, concept properties and relationships
rxnorm_rxnav.window_coverage: current NDC catalog; historical API lookup available per RxCUI

who_atc_ddd.name: WHO Collaborating Centre ATC/DDD Index
who_atc_ddd.access: portal access/licensing applies to complete machine-readable index and historical annual files
who_atc_ddd.coverage: annual ATC classification and DDD assignments
who_atc_ddd.window_coverage: 2012-2022 requested; not downloaded without an authorized machine-readable release

census_naics.name: U.S. Census NAICS concordances
census_naics.coverage: 2012 and 2017 NAICS; NAICS↔ISIC and adjacent revisions
census_naics.window_coverage: 2012 and 2017 revisions directly cover the focus window; 2022 revision is catalogued when published

wits_product_concordances.name: World Bank WITS product concordances
wits_product_concordances.access: interactive portal; account/workflow may be required for downloads
wits_product_concordances.coverage: HS, SITC, BEC, ISIC correspondence tables
wits_product_concordances.window_coverage: HS revisions relevant to 2012-2022; no stable unauthenticated bulk endpoint assumed

gleif_lei.name: GLEIF LEI Golden Copy / API
gleif_lei.access: free public API and bulk files
gleif_lei.coverage: current and historical reference fields in current LEI records
gleif_lei.granularity: legal entity, parent relationships, address and status
gleif_lei.window_coverage: current API extract; historical point-in-time reconstruction requires archived/delta files

hud_usps_crosswalk.name: HUD USPS ZIP Code Crosswalk
hud_usps_crosswalk.access: login/access token required by current HUD portal/API
hud_usps_crosswalk.window_coverage: 2012 Q1–2022 Q4 uses 2010 Census geographies; not downloaded without credentials

dartmouth_atlas.name: Dartmouth Atlas ZIP-HSA-HRR crosswalks
dartmouth_atlas.access: free public downloads subject to data-use terms
dartmouth_atlas.window_coverage: 2012-2019 public annual files; this run normalized 2018-2019 CSV ZIP files and retained 2012-2017 legacy XLS files pending parser support; 2020-2022 not listed on the official supplemental page
